name: Somchai Srisupan
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport finance began unconventionally, through a family-owned auto repair shop. He quickly developed an understanding for the intricate costs associated with performance and maintenance. His keen eye for detail and financial acumen led him to pursue a degree in economics, which he leveraged to secure a role at a local racing team before joining Reiza Racing Academy.

At Reiza, Somchai meticulously manages the team's budget, ensuring financial stability and strategic allocation of resources. He takes pride in providing accurate financial forecasts and identifying cost-saving opportunities, allowing the team to invest in crucial upgrades and talent development. He is known for his pragmatic approach and ability to navigate complex financial landscapes.

His loyalty extends beyond the balance sheet; Somchai is a respected mentor within the academy, guiding young engineers and mechanics on financial literacy and responsible spending. He believes in transparency and fostering a financially sound environment for everyone.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a lean build and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus for quick calculations.
Insists on reviewing every invoice personally, no matter how small.
Starts his day with a cup of strong Thai iced coffee.
